# Plugin catalog

Every plugin in the `pmcro-plugins` marketplace. Add the marketplace once, then install by name:

```
/plugin marketplace add Tooensure-LLC/pmcro
/plugin install <plugin>@pmcro-plugins
```

## PMCR-O plugins (13)

| Plugin | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `pmcro-capture` | Turn a captured demonstration (screenshots or photos plus notes) into a draft skill, with private metadata stripped and a human review gate. |
| `pmcro-cloudflare` | PMCR-O website and landing-page setup on Cloudflare, with affiliate-disclosure checks, trail frames for each step, and deploys gated behind human approval. |
| `pmcro-content` | PMCR-O content creation: scripts in the founder's own voice with sourced claims, and guardrails for synthetic voice and image. |
| `pmcro-core` | PMCR-O role skills (Orchestrator, Planner, Maker, Checker, Reflector) and the Trail Player for recording direction with disclosure tiers. |
| `pmcro-csuite` | DEPRECATED: use pmcro-seats, which follows the company roster. Imported C-Suite domain skills (CEO, CFO, COO, CTO, CMO, CRO, CHRO, CLO, Chief of Staff) kept for reference until the owner decides to remove them. |
| `pmcro-dotnet` | PMCR-O .NET and Microsoft Agent Framework skills, built so small local models can use them through progressive disclosure. |
| `pmcro-figma` | Template-driven Figma plugins: render a template into code.ts and ui.html, lint it against Figma's authoring rules, then hand the files to Figma's own MCP. |
| `pmcro-mcpserver` | Generate the company's MCP servers: a read-only server that serves every plugin's skills with progressive disclosure, plus a .NET server generator in the owner's pattern. |
| `pmcro-memory` | Shared, tiered, append-only memory for the founder and every agent: the company's knowledge, searchable, with provenance and human-owned acceptance. |
| `pmcro-seats` | Talk to the PMCR-O C-Suite: one read-only agent per company seat (15, generated from company.json), plus skills to ask one seat or convene a round table. |
| `pmcro-social` | PMCR-O account operations: a credential-free registry of the founder's accounts, a weekly brief of what needs a human, and rules for drafting and approving posts. |
| `pmcro-toggles` | Feature-toggle governance for PMCR-O: every flag in an OpenFeature flags.json has an owner, an expiry and a removal plan, and a read-only check finds expired, orphaned and mistyped flags. |
| `pmcro-training` | Validate and gate PMCR-O fine-tuning datasets (SFT JSONL) against the owner's working schema before any training run. |

## Pinned upstream plugins (15)

Listed from [dotnet/skills](https://github.com/dotnet/skills) at a pinned commit, not copied (ADR 0004).

| Plugin | What it does |
| --- | --- |

| `dotnet-advanced` | Advanced .NET and C# skills for niche scenarios that are not part of the core dotnet plugin. |
| `dotnet-data` | Skills for .NET data access and Entity Framework related tasks. |
| `dotnet-diag` | Skills for .NET performance investigations, debugging, and incident analysis. |
| `dotnet-msbuild` | Comprehensive MSBuild and .NET build skills: failure diagnosis, performance optimization, code quality, and modernization. |
| `dotnet-nuget` | NuGet and .NET package management: dependency management and modernization. |
| `dotnet-upgrade` | Skills for migrating and upgrading .NET projects across framework versions, language features, and compatibility targets. |
| `dotnet-maui` | Skills for .NET MAUI development: environment setup, diagnostics, troubleshooting, navigation, data binding, dependency injection, layout, and theming. |
| `dotnet-ai` | AI and ML skills for .NET: technology selection, LLM integration, agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, MCP, and classic ML with ML.NET. |
| `dotnet-template-engine` | .NET Template Engine skills: template discovery, project scaffolding, and template authoring. |
| `dotnet-test` | Skills for running, generating, analyzing, and improving .NET tests: test execution, filtering, platform detection, coverage, testability, and MSTest workflows. |
| `dotnet-test-migration` | Skills and an orchestrator agent for migrating .NET test frameworks and platforms: MSTest and xUnit version upgrades, xUnit-to-MSTest conversion, and VSTest to Microsoft.Testing.Platform. |
| `dotnet-aspnetcore` | ASP.NET Core web development skills including middleware, endpoints, real-time communication, and API patterns. |
| `dotnet-blazor` | Skills for Blazor development: component authoring, interactivity, and web application patterns. |
| `dotnet11` | Skills for new .NET 11 APIs and language features. |

Status: CANDIDATE. Each plugin's own README states what was and was not tested.
